title: Youki ni Naritai Shigure-san
titleNative: 陽キになりたい時雨さん
synopsis: In modern times, it seems like the world only has need for extroverts. They're fun, sociable, thoughtful, and basically top-tier humans. But Yoshida isn't like that... She boldly declares she's going to become an extrovert, and she challenges Yoshida to do the same...!? Watch as these two high school students try to make the most of their youth, while they still can!

synopsis: Manga adaptation of Part 5 of Honzuki no Gekokujou . Winter looms heavy in Ehrenfest, where Ferdinand departed. A tip-off about Georgine, a "Goddess of Chaos" who revels in mayhem, hastens the purge. Meanwhile, Rozemyne, now a third-year student at the Royal Academy, is busy trying to shake off her sense of loss. In the dormitory, she persuades the children of Veronica's former faction to avoid being implicated, while the first day of classes for lord candidates begins at the academy. With exams for the civil service course, an encounter with a new senior librarian, and a major in the specialized course, she plunges into a life of drastic change in both her position and her environment from a year ago. As she gradually regains her "self," and even receives the blessings of the gods, Rozemyne's rampage becomes even more unstoppable! "Spread my book-loving virus to everyone!" (Source: Corona EX, translated)
